sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (ESA, 30 m) - surface model, flattened by the sim on paved areas
sources.photo: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance, median of 4 clear days per season (spring: Mar-Apr 2025, summer: Jul-Aug 2025), natural colour, 10 m
sources.land_cover: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m): built-up -> estimated houses, tree cover -> trees
sources.land_use: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via Overture Maps: parks, pitches, cemeteries, schools, hospitals, industry, tree rows
sources.places: Overture Maps places (CDLA Permissive 2.0): mosques, fuel stations, shop density for building heights
sources.airport: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) via Overture Maps 2026-11-18.0; runway size from OpenAIP
